name: Cereal Milk Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Cereal Milk is a sativa dominant hybrid strain that is dense and creamy with a strong sweet and starchy aroma. This strain’s aroma and flavor contain notes of toasted bread, caramelized fruit, and strawberry over a light earthy base. Cereal Milk will make you feel both calm and happy. Its dominant terpenes are D-Limonene and Myrcene.
